definition.en: A figure that can be folded along a line so that the two halves match exactly. (Mainland Chinese textbooks say 轴对称图形.)
definition.zh: 能沿一条线对折、两半完全重合的图形。（中国大陆课本叫“轴对称图形”。）

definition.en: The line along which a figure folds so that its two halves match exactly.
definition.zh: 让图形对折后两半完全重合的那条线。

definition.en: To bend paper along a line so that one side lies on the other. The same word as in the fractions lesson.
definition.zh: 沿一条线把纸折过来，让两边贴在一起。和分数主题里的“对折”是同一个词。

definition.en: After folding, the two halves cover each other with nothing left over and nothing missing.
definition.zh: 折过来以后，两半互相盖住，一点也不多、一点也不少。

definition.en: The point on the other side of the line of symmetry, the same distance from it. Books also say corresponding point.
definition.zh: 对称轴另一边、离轴一样远的那个点。英文书上也说 corresponding point。

definition.en: One of the two triangles a grid square makes when it is cut from corner to corner.
definition.zh: 一个方格沿对角线切开得到的两个三角形之一。

definition.en: Paper or a picture covered with equal squares.
definition.zh: 画满一样大正方形的纸或图。

definition.en: A straight line joining two corners of a shape that are not next to each other. This lesson only folds along it.
definition.zh: 连接图形两个不相邻顶点的线段。本课只说“沿对角线折”。

definition.en: A four-sided shape with two pairs of equal sides next to each other, like a kite. It has one line of symmetry.
definition.zh: 有两组相邻的边分别相等的四边形，样子像风筝。它有一条对称轴。
